title: When the finite Circle consumer must reject

declarations.name: circle_public_consumer_gate_promotion_overclaim_rejected
declarations.premises: Any one of three fixture flags asserts an upward transition, chapter promotion or deployed transport.
declarations.conclusion: The fixture fails the finite acceptance contract.

declarations.name: circle_public_consumer_gate_missing_mutation_control_rejected
declarations.premises: At least one required digest, missing-theorem, stale-contract or transfer rejection flag is false.
declarations.conclusion: The fixture fails acceptance. Execution of the four mutation trials is a separate observation.

title: Which route is cheapest under the declared costs?

declarations.name: selected_route_is_a_listed_eligible_candidate
declarations.premises: The finite selector returns this route from the supplied candidates.
declarations.conclusion: The selected route belongs to the list and meets its eligibility predicate.

declarations.name: selected_route_has_minimum_modeled_cost
declarations.premises: The selector returns a route, and the alternative is an eligible member of the same list.
declarations.conclusion: The selected total cost is at most the alternative’s modeled cost. Measured production cost remains open.

title: Which jurisdiction does a mandate cover?

declarations.name: local_mandate_cannot_authorize_distinct_jurisdiction
declarations.premises: The proposed jurisdiction differs from the jurisdiction recorded in the mandate.
declarations.conclusion: The modeled use fails even with the mandate’s own authority identity.

declarations.name: participation_signals_cannot_recover_representation
declarations.premises: A classifier sees only participation signals in the finite model.
declarations.conclusion: Identical signals can hide different representation states, so such a classifier cannot recover every state.

declarations.name: commitment_signals_cannot_recover_effective_enforcement
declarations.premises: The classifier sees only modeled commitment signals.
declarations.conclusion: Those signals cannot recover effective enforcement in every encoded case.

declarations.name: provider_signals_cannot_recover_population_resilience
declarations.premises: A classifier receives only provider signals for the authored population cases.
declarations.conclusion: Every such classifier misses at least one modeled resilience state.

title: What does a lease proof establish?

declarations.name: accepted_lease_is_bounded_versioned_and_unexpired
declarations.premises: Issuance of a lease is the event kind and the authority transaction accepts it.
declarations.conclusion: The new version advances once, its ceiling does not increase and model time precedes expiration.

declarations.name: accepted_secret_injection_is_scoped_mediated_and_preexpiry
declarations.premises: A secret-injection event is accepted by the same modeled transaction.
declarations.conclusion: Acceptance entails the modeled scope, mediation and pre-expiry checks. Sensor coverage is outside the proposition.
